cim_eredeti: Week 8 Big 12 football picks using ChatGPT
szoveg_eredeti:
Week 8 is here and that means it is time to check in how artificial intelligence is going to make its pick using 100 simulations. We are now 100% in conference play which will give us a better idea of the Big 12 standings once this week is over.

The biggest game of the week will have to wait until about 8:15 p.m. MT when the No. 14 ranked Houston Cougars travel to play the No. 10 Utah Utes. This is another ESPN GameDay apperance for the conference as they are setting up shop in Salt Lake City.

The Utes struggled last week in a 27-24 win over Colorado and have yet to play a team with a winning record. Utah has been beating up on bad teams. Houston is not a bad team. The Willie Fritz-led program gave Texas Tech a battle to the end and have a great offense led by quarterback Connor Weigman who has 20 touchdowns to just two interceptions.

The Utes are healthy favorite and the chatbot agrees and picks Utah to win 32-26 and an unusually high 70 out of 100 times. If Utah can get past Houston, then they should be considered the real deal.

BYU is hoping to avoid any hangover after the Notre Dame win as they head two time zones to Florida to face UCF. The line has dropped from double-digits to now at 6.5-points, which is concerning for BYU fans. AI doesn't see a drop off with BYU winning by an average score of 25-19 and winning 65 times.

The closest game of the weekend is an odd one in Baylor at Kansas. The Bears are playing much better this year and Dave Aranda's job might be safe and have been playing better than the Jayhawks this year. Baylor has four wins and both were close, whereas, Kansas is just 2-4. Despite that difference the home crowd is being taking into consideration. It is basically a toss up with Baylor winning 51 of 49 games to get one step closer to bowl eligibility.

The biggest projected blowout is Colorado travleling to Oklahoma State. The Buffaloes defense does play like a competent unit, but the offense now led by Isaac Wilson is not capable at all. This being a road game, the Cowboys are a heavy favorite and treated that way by projected to win 80% of the time.
